verdict: Paid campaigns paused Aug 6; 45 leads came in before the stop.
narrative: Over the full 28 days you received 45 leads at a cost of $26.04 per lead, entirely from Meta — but all of that activity came before August 6, when paid campaigns went on pause. The efficiency trend was actually improving in the final days before the stop: the last three active days produced 9 leads against only 5 in the three days prior. While campaigns have been paused, organic visibility has softened as well, with Google Business Profile engagement down 23.4% and Instagram reach near zero this week, removing the usual organic cushion. The campaign restart decision is the immediate priority, and once paid activity resumes you should expect lead volume to recover toward pre-pause levels given the strong close-out efficiency.
